MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb
WITH collect(DISTINCT {k:a.issueKey,p:pa.projectKey,l:r.linkId}) + collect(DISTINCT {k:b.issueKey,p:pb.projectKey,l:r.linkId}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS x
WITH x.p AS p, collect(DISTINCT x.k) AS ks, collect(DISTINCT x.l) AS ls
RETURN p AS id, size(ks) AS value, ks, ls ORDER BY value DESC

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue)
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND (pa.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR pb.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [a.issueKey,b.issueKey] AS i
RETURN DISTINCT i AS issue

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue)
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND (pa.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR pb.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
RETURN DISTINCT r.linkId AS link

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue)
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL
WITH pa.projectKey AS p, collect(DISTINCT a.issueKey) AS x, pb.projectKey AS q, collect(DISTINCT b.issueKey) AS y
UNWIND [[p,x],[q,y]] AS t
WITH t[0] AS id, t[1] AS ks UNWIND ks AS k
WITH id, count(DISTINCT k) AS c
RETURN id, c LIMIT 0

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue)
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL
UNWIND [[pa.projectKey,a.issueKey],[pb.projectKey,b.issueKey]] AS t
WITH t[0] AS id, count(DISTINCT t[1]) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
RETURN id, value
